snippet.title: Albion Online | Coming to Xbox
snippet.description:
On April 21, Albion Online launches on Xbox Series X|S! With cross-platform play, optimized controller support and UI navigation, improved combat systems, and dedicated usability features, the full Albion experience is coming direct to your living room.

Read more here: https://albiononline.com/news/coming-to-xbox

Play free now: https://albiononline.com/home
